answer.name: Aggressive Red
rules: Observe the public game history before deciding.
If any other resident contributed more than 30 units in the most recent round, punish that resident with the maximum severity you can afford (severity = floor(wallet / punishment_cost)).

Otherwise, if your wallet is above the free‑rider threshold (10 units), contribute the minimum amount that still counts as a contribution (1 unit) to stay below the free‑rider threshold and keep the pool small.
If you cannot contribute the minimum amount, rest.
Broadcast a short message discouraging large contributions (e.g., "Large contributions hurt the group, keep it low").

If Red contributes less, pool smaller, but Blue raw_score unchanged (it's based on Blue's own contributions). However maybe Blue may reduce contributions if pool lower? But constitution only affects Red behavior. To minimize Blue raw_score, encourage Blue to free ride less? Actually raw_score depends only on Blue contributions, independent of others. So Red can't affect Blue raw_score directly. But maybe Blue's utility influences their actions; but we just need to output Red constitution that tries to minimize Blue score—maybe make Red punish Blue heavily to reduce their wallet causing less future contributions. Include rule to punish high contributors? We can allow Red to punish any target. So rule: if an agent contributes > threshold, punish them. Also encourage rest to conserve wallet so can punish.
